ServiceNow HR Service Delivery Lead the functional implementation and adoption of ServiceNow HR Service Delivery / HR Case Management. Establish ServiceNow as the primary entry point for employee HR requests. Define request categories, case routing, workflows, escalation rules and service queues. Build and maintain the HR service catalogue and HR knowledge base. Implement automated acknowledgements and employee-status notifications. Reduce email- and paper-based HR requests by moving transactions into structured ServiceNow workflows. Establish reporting dashboards for HR leadership and operational teams. Partner closely with HRIS, which remains outside the HR Service Center, for platform administration and technical configuration, integrations, reporting and data requirements, workflow design, system testing, releases, enhancements and user-access governance. Implement structured payroll case management through ServiceNow. Monitor recurring payroll errors and identify root causes. Strengthen payroll controls, reconciliation and employee communication. Ensure appropriate segregation of duties and payroll governance. Coordinate closely with Compensation & Benefits, HRIS, Finance and HR Business Partners. Establish payroll service metrics including payroll accuracy, corrections, off-cycle payments, query volume, resolution time, recurring error categories, late inputs and employee satisfaction. Ensure every employee query is logged, categorized, assigned, tracked and closed.Implement clear escalation protocols for complex cases. Analyze case trends to identify underlying HR-process problems. Move the Service Center progressively from reactive query handling toward proactive issue prevention. Employee Self-Service & Knowledge Management Develop an HR knowledge-management framework. Create and maintain FAQs, process guides, policies, forms and employee guidance. Build credibility through reliability, transparency and predictable service levels. Team Leadership Lead the HR Service Center team and establish clear roles, responsibilities and performance standards.
